evidence.observation: Two independently paced traversals reconcile the same 37 currently recoverable Page-level records, with explicit denominator, terminal controls, full disposition, and lifetime-population exclusions.

The corpus, route inventory, campaign pages, fundraiser, press, print artifact, response specimen, implementation archive, naming recollection, and non-poster statement are distinct sources with explicit support and non-support boundaries.

Population, campaign practice, announcement count, mutable reactions, bounded stakeholder response, route inventory, fundraising outcome, digital operations, and naming support remain separate claims.

Jamie's implementation role is supported by site, theme, widget, deployment, and launch records. His non-poster statement now has a dedicated first-party intake and source linked to the role claim and inquiry.
The ProjectRecord and dossier distinguish documented implementation work from Jamie's attributed naming recollection. Uniform public identifiers corroborate only the identity outcome.
The dossier preserves campaign purpose, named organizers, fiscal sponsorship, operating system, Jamie's bounded role, corpus findings, research queue, and protected-material boundaries.

The candidate distinguishes current recoverability from historical completeness, announcements from payment proof, reactions from impact, routes from endorsement, and first-person statements from publisher ledgers.
All new claims remain internal-only with no active projections; mutable metrics, relational evidence, unresolved leads, and private artifacts remain outside public composition.

All 62 lifecycle tests pass, including adversarial checks for population inflation, role inflation, Page-author attribution, engagement-to-impact conversion, URL-to-endorsement conversion, and sole naming credit.
